name: Legend of the Vagabond Sword/Battlesong: Ingenious Impermanence
description:
Battlesong: Ingenious Impermanence I
Challenge the Dual Maguu Kenki: Lone Gale and Galloping Frost.
A pair of mysterious puppets lost in the endless process of honing their combat skills finally meet a fearless wanderer in the depths of the world.
Their mechanical bodies and hearts may keep them alive for a thousand years or more, but how many worthy foes can they meet in that time, and how many legendary battles will they fight?
Battlesong: Ingenious Impermanence II
Challenge the Dual Maguu Kenki: Lone Gale and Galloping Frost.
